repos_dropped.reason: Old passed after exact upstream dependency pins, but HEAD deterministically failed test_write_timeout[trio] on an unraisable async-generator ResourceWarning across three runs.
HEAD had three deterministic ANSI snapshot failures under the compatible Pygments 2.18 pin; newer Pygments increased failures, so the suite is dependency-sensitive.
Both revisions failed clean-suite probing: old had Trio behavior failures and HEAD's sourceless-install test attempted nested package setup incompatible with offline execution.
The pytest configuration required additional flaky/devpi plugins and nested environment machinery; it did not produce a clean suite within the 20-minute repository time-box.
The old core suite had 158 failures from unbounded Click/plugin compatibility and HEAD retained nine plugin/config snapshot failures; dropped rather than patching its test environment.
